summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K attaching a UK TR-1 major-holdings notification, the UK equivalent of a Schedule 13G/13D ownership disclosure. The Capital Group Companies, Inc. (Los Angeles) reported crossing below the threshold, with total voting rights of 17.975584% (387,324,693 votes) versus a prior 18.023677%, after a disposal of voting rights on 04/11/2026, notified 05/11/2026. Holdings split between 13.349128% ordinary shares (GB0002875804) and 4.626456% depositary receipts (US1104481072); no financial instruments. This is a routine passive ownership update, not a special situation; watch for further TR-1 filings as the stake drifts near 18%.
